consent.title: Connect {app} to Polaris
consent.unverified: The name is what the app says about itself. Check the address it sends you back to.
consent.loopback: This app runs on this computer. Only continue if you just started the connection yourself.
consent.scopesHint: Untick anything it should not do. It can never do more than your account can.
consent.withheld: Asked for, but your account cannot: {scopes}
consent.noneHeld: Your account has none of the permissions this app asks for, so there is nothing to grant.
consent.pickOne: Choose at least one permission, or deny.
consent.later: You can change or disconnect it at any time under Account > AI assistants.

errors.client: Polaris does not recognize the app asking to connect. Start the connection again from the app. If it happens again, remove Polaris from the app and add it back.
errors.clientDetails: Polaris could not read the details this app publishes about itself, so it cannot check where to send you back. Try connecting again from the app in a few minutes.
errors.clientRefused: Polaris does not accept the details this app publishes about itself, so it cannot connect it. Trying again will not change this.
errors.redirect: This link would send you to an address the app never registered, so it was stopped. Start the connection again from the app.
errors.viewingAs: You are viewing Polaris as someone else. Stop viewing as them to connect an app to your own account.
errors.tooMany: Too many connection attempts. Wait a few minutes and start again from the app.
errors.failed: Polaris could not finish connecting the app. Start again from the app.

consent.sensitiveHint: Acts outside Polaris or on real devices
consent.abilitiesNone: Nothing on this Polaris uses it yet.

scopes.chat_use: Read and post in your conversations
scopes.databases_read: See your databases and read their data
scopes.gameservers_read: See game servers and who is playing
scopes.gameservers_moderate: Kick, ban and time out players, and run the whitelist
scopes.gameservers_manage: Start, stop and restart game servers, and use their consoles, worlds and access lists
scopes.places_read: See the devices in your places
scopes.places_cameras: See a still picture from your cameras

page.title: AI assistants
page.intro: See what each connected assistant may do, change it, or connect another.

connectedApps.title: Connected assistants
connectedApps.intro: Assistants and editors you allowed to act for you over MCP. Each one can do only what you approved, and never more than your account.
connectedApps.empty: No assistants connected yet. Connect one with the steps below.
connectedApps.disconnectDescription: It stops working at once. To use it again, connect it from the app.
connectedApps.failed: That app could not be disconnected. Reload and try again.
connectedApps.idle: Not used in the last 7 days
connectedApps.editHint: Changes apply on its next call. Anything it did not ask for is marked, and stays off until you tick it.
connectedApps.notRequested: Not asked for by this app
connectedApps.pickOne: Choose at least one permission, or disconnect it.
connectedApps.changeFailed: The permissions could not be changed. Reload and try again.

ip.title: Where {app} may connect from
ip.hint: Checked on every call and every token refresh, on top of your account access rules.

none.label: From any address
none.hint: No address rule of its own.

origin.label: Only the address it was approved from
origin.hint: {ip}. For assistants on your own device or network.

list.label: Addresses I choose
list.hint: An allow list and a deny list of IP addresses or ranges.

sessions.label: Only where I am signed in
sessions.hint: Addresses of your active Polaris sessions, for assistants on your own devices. It stops working when you sign out everywhere.

ip.noOrigin: Not recorded for this connection. Connect it again to use this.
ip.allowHint: Leave empty to allow everything that is not denied.
ip.denyHint: Blocked addresses are refused even if they are allowed.
ip.invalid: Enter an IP address or a CIDR range.

summary.sessions: Only from where you are signed in
summary.list: {allow, plural, =0 {Any address} one {# allowed address} other {# allowed addresses}}, {deny, plural, =0 {none denied} one {# denied} other {# denied}}

ip.failed: The address rule could not be saved. Reload and try again.

exception.title: Also allow from
exception.hint: Calls from these places get through even where your account's network rules refuse them. Only this connection; the address rule above still applies.
exception.adminOnly: Only an administrator can let a connection past the network rules an administrator set.

openai.label: OpenAI's published addresses (ChatGPT)
openai.hint: The list OpenAI publishes for ChatGPT connectors, kept up to date.

exception.failed: The exception could not be saved. Reload and try again.

restricted.body: Your account only accepts calls from certain places, so assistants that call from their own servers, such as ChatGPT or Claude on the web, are refused.
restricted.howTo: To let one in, open where that connection may connect from and add its country or addresses under Also allow from.
restricted.askAdmin: Only an administrator can let a connection past these rules.
